actions.label: Registry-backed blank library
actions.expected: All 17 canonical node types are discoverable before graph mutation.
actions.actual: Found 17 registry rows in canonical order.

actions.label: Capture the blank registry-backed library
actions.expected: A fresh blank document visibly exposes the searchable Node Library.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Add prompt.text from Node Library
actions.expected: The registry factory creates prompt.text with canonical defaults.

actions.label: Add prompt.worker from Node Library
actions.expected: The registry factory creates prompt.worker with canonical defaults.

actions.label: Move Worker with ordinary left drag
actions.expected: The Worker moves once and preserves its graph identity.

actions.label: Fit the moved nodes
actions.expected: The two authored nodes return to a clear marquee workspace without changing their saved positions.

actions.label: Marquee-select Prompt
actions.expected: A left-drag marquee selects the intersected Prompt.

actions.label: Add Worker with Shift marquee
actions.expected: Shift marquee preserves Prompt and adds Worker.

actions.label: Pan with ordinary right drag
actions.expected: The canvas viewport moves while the two-node selection remains unchanged.

actions.label: Capture movement and additive marquee
actions.expected: The separated nodes show one reliable movement and two-node additive selection state.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Duplicate selected nodes
actions.expected: Ctrl+D duplicates the two selected nodes with a visible offset.

actions.label: Copy graph selection
actions.expected: Ctrl+C records the selected graph subgraph.

actions.label: Paste graph selection
actions.expected: Ctrl+V pastes the selected subgraph with fresh graph identities.

actions.label: Delete pasted graph selection
actions.expected: Delete removes the current graph selection.

actions.label: Undo graph delete
actions.expected: Ctrl+Z restores the deleted graph selection.

actions.label: Redo graph delete
actions.expected: Ctrl+Y reapplies the graph deletion.

actions.label: Select every current node
actions.expected: Ctrl+A selects every node when the canvas owns focus.

actions.label: Primary graph shortcuts
actions.expected: Duplicate, clipboard, delete, undo, redo, and select-all change the durable graph.

actions.label: Rename the primary selected node
actions.expected: F2 opens one controlled title editor.

actions.label: Commit the direct title edit
actions.expected: Enter commits the renamed title as one graph transaction.

actions.label: Restore canvas-owned node focus
actions.expected: The renamed Prompt is the primary selected graph object.

actions.label: Open primary content editing
actions.expected: Enter edits the selected Prompt primary content rather than moving the node.

actions.label: Capture controlled direct editing
actions.expected: The selected Prompt visibly owns the only bounded on-canvas editor.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Commit primary content edit
actions.expected: Ctrl+Enter commits text while the editor owns focus.

actions.label: Refit before Worker editing
actions.expected: The edited cards return to a clear direct-editing workspace.

actions.label: Edit Worker instruction on canvas
actions.expected: Double-click opens the visible Worker's primary instruction directly on its card.

actions.label: Commit Worker instruction edit
actions.expected: Ctrl+Enter saves the Worker's instruction as one graph transaction.

actions.label: Restore Prompt command focus
actions.expected: The directly edited Prompt remains the primary graph selection.

actions.label: Select the preview graph scope
actions.expected: The preview scope includes the blank-authored Workers without starting provider work.

actions.label: Preview the selected run
actions.expected: Ctrl+Enter reaches provider capability validation without starting provider work.

actions.label: Provider-free run preview
actions.expected: The shortcut is wired while an unconfigured blank profile remains provider-safe.
actions.actual: Preview stopped at the visible capability guard; no provider work started.
